1. 电脑和电视连接同一路由器，优先使用有线网络或 5GHz Wi-Fi。\n2:
1. Connect the PC and TV to the same router; prefer Ethernet or 5GHz Wi-Fi.
2. Open Sunshine management and create your account.
3. Install Moonlight on the TV, select this PC, and enter its PIN in Sunshine.
4. Select a physical or virtual screen here, then open Desktop on the TV.
5. Start with 1440p / 60 FPS / H.264 / HDR off, and adjust to your decoder.

• Sunshine 使用默认安装位置：Program Files\\Sunsh:
• Sunshine uses its default Program Files\Sunshine installation.
• Normal use needs no administrator access; setup and system changes request approval.
• Capture changes create a Sunshine configuration backup.
• The Offline package supports initialization and skips installed components.
• Windows display settings select active virtual-screen modes.
• Normal exit releases managed virtual screens. Physical-screen streaming may continue. Stop ends the service and releases virtual screens.
